mapper.sql: user_metrics AS ( SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.rank_id, u.type_id, u.unit_code, u.unit_name, u.discharge_date, COALESCE(account.current_savings, 0) AS current_savings, COALESCE( LEAST( 100.0, ROUND( COALESCE(account.monthly_savings, 0) / NULLIF(mr.rank_salary, 0) * 100, 1 ) ), 0.0 ) AS savings_rate FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN military_rank mr ON u.rank_id = mr.rank_id AND mr.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(monthly_save) AS monthly_savings, SUM(curr_amount) AS current_savings FROM saving_account WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY user_id ) account ON u.id = account.user_id WHERE u.del_yn = 'N' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' )

mapper.sql: veteran_account_progress AS ( SELECT account.account_id, account.user_id, account.curr_amount, account.monthly_count, account.account_status, CASE WHEN account.account_status = 'MATURED' THEN 100.0 ELSE LEAST( 100.0, ROUND( account.monthly_count * 100.0 / NULLIF( LEAST( 24, GREATEST( 1, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MONTH, DATE(COALESCE( account.open_date, account.created_date)), member.discharge_date ) + 1 ) ), 0 ), 1 ) ) END AS completion_rate FROM saving_account account JOIN `user` member ON account.user_id = member.id WHERE account.del_yn = 'N' AND account.account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED', 'TERMINATED') AND member.del_yn = 'N' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND member.discharge_date < CURRENT_DATE ), veteran_account_totals AS ( SELECT user_id, SUM(curr_amount) AS total_contribution, ROUND( SUM(curr_amount) / NULLIF(MAX(monthly_count), 0), 0 ) AS fallback_monthly_contribution, ROUND(AVG(completion_rate), 1) AS completion_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN account_status = 'MATURED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matured_account_count FROM veteran_account_progress GROUP BY user_id ), veteran_history_totals AS ( SELECT account.user_id, ROUND( SUM(history.pay_amount) / NULLIF( COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE(history.paid_date, DATE(history.created_date)), '%Y-%m' )), 0 ), 0 ) AS average_monthly_contribution FROM saving_history history JOIN saving_account account ON history.account_id = account.account_id JOIN `user` member ON account.user_id = member.id WHERE history.del_yn = 'N' AND account.del_yn = 'N' AND account.account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED', 'TERMINATED') AND member.del_yn = 'N' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND member.discharge_date < CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY account.user_id ), veteran_metrics AS ( SELECT member.id AS user_id, member.type_id, member.unit_code, member.unit_name, member.discharge_date, COALESCE(account.total_contribution, 0) AS total_contribution, COALESCE( history.average_monthly_contribution, account.fallback_monthly_contribution, 0 ) AS average_monthly_contribution, COALESCE(account.completion_rate, 0.0) AS completion_rate, COALESCE(account.matured_account_count, 0) AS matured_account_count FROM `user` member LEFT JOIN veteran_account_totals account ON member.id = account.user_id LEFT JOIN veteran_history_totals history ON member.id = history.user_id WHERE member.del_yn = 'N' AND member.status = 'ACTIVE' AND member.discharge_date < CURRENT_DATE )

unit_stats AS ( SELECT unit_code, MAX(unit_name) AS unit_name, ROUND(AVG(savings_rate), 1) AS savings_rate FROM user_metrics WHERE unit_code IS NOT NULL AND unit_code != '' AND (discharge_date IS NULL OR discharge_date >= CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY unit_code
HAVING ROUND(AVG(savings_rate), 1) > 0 ), ranked_units AS ( SELECT unit_code, unit_name, savings_rate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY savings_rate DESC) AS unit_rank FROM unit_stats )

veteran_unit_stats AS ( SELECT unit_code, MAX(unit_name) AS unit_name, ROUND(AVG(completion_rate), 1) AS metric_value FROM veteran_metrics WHERE unit_code IS NOT NULL AND unit_code != '' GROUP BY unit_code HAVING ROUND(AVG(completion_rate), 1) > 0 ), ranked_veteran_units AS ( SELECT unit_code, unit_name, metric_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY metric_value DESC) AS unit_rank FROM veteran_unit_stats )
mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name, u.rank_id AS rankId, mr.rank_name AS rankName, u.type_id AS typeId, mt.type_name AS typeName, u.unit_name AS unitName, u.unit_code AS unitCode, u.discharge_date AS dischargeDate, COALESCE(account.current_savings, 0) AS currentSavings, COALESCE( LEAST( 100.0, ROUND( COALESCE(account.monthly_savings, 0) / NULLIF(mr.rank_salary, 0) * 100, 1 ) ), 0.0 ) AS savingsRate FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN military_rank mr ON u.rank_id = mr.rank_id AND mr.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN military_types mt ON u.type_id = mt.type_id AND mt.del_yn = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUM(monthly_save) AS monthly_savings, SUM(curr_amount) AS current_savings FROM saving_account WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND account_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY user_id ) account ON u.id = account.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'

WITH , scoped_metrics AS ( SELECT metrics.user_id, metrics.savings_rate FROM user_metrics metrics WHERE ), my_metrics AS ( SELECT savings_rate FROM scoped_metrics WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT 1 + SUM(CASE WHEN metrics.savings_rate > me.savings_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `rank`, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN metrics.savings_rate > me.savings_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higherCount, SUM(CASE WHEN metrics.savings_rate < me.savings_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowerCount FROM scoped_metrics metrics CROSS JOIN my_metrics me

WITH , scoped_metrics AS ( SELECT metrics.* FROM veteran_metrics metrics WHERE ), my_metrics AS ( SELECT * FROM scoped_metrics WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT me.total_contribution AS totalContribution, me.average_monthly_contribution AS averageMonthlyContribution, me.completion_rate AS savingsCompletionRate, me.matured_account_count AS maturedAccountCount, ROUND(AVG(metrics.total_contribution), 0) AS peerAverageTotalContribution, ROUND(AVG(metrics.average_monthly_contribution), 0) AS peerAverageMonthlyContribution, ROUND(AVG(metrics.completion_rate), 1) AS peerAverageCompletionRate, 1 + SUM( CASE WHEN metrics.completion_rate > me.completion_rate THEN 1 WHEN metrics.completion_rate = me.completion_rate AND metrics.total_contribution > me.total_contribution THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS `rank`, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM( CASE WHEN metrics.completion_rate > me.completion_rate THEN 1 WHEN metrics.completion_rate = me.completion_rate AND metrics.total_contribution > me.total_contribution THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS higherCount, SUM( CASE WHEN metrics.completion_rate < me.completion_rate THEN 1 WHEN metrics.completion_rate = me.completion_rate AND metrics.total_contribution < me.total_contribution THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS lowerCount FROM my_metrics me CROSS JOIN scoped_metrics metrics GROUP BY me.total_contribution, me.average_monthly_contribution, me.completion_rate, me.matured_account_count

SELECT badge.badge_id AS badgeId, badge.badge_name AS badgeName, CASE WHEN MAX(user_badge.id) IS NULL THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS achieved, MAX(user_badge.created_date) AS achievedDate FROM badge LEFT JOIN user_badge ON badge.badge_id = user_badge.badge_id AND user_badge.user_id = #{userId} AND user_badge.del_yn = 'N' WHERE badge.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY badge.badge_id, badge.badge_name ORDER BY badge.badge_id

WITH , peer_metrics AS ( SELECT metrics.* FROM user_metrics metrics CROSS JOIN (SELECT rank_id FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId}) me WHERE (me.rank_id IS NULL OR metrics.rank_id = me.rank_id) AND (metrics.discharge_date IS NULL OR metrics.discharge_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ), ranked_metrics AS ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY savings_rate DESC) AS peer_position, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count FROM peer_metrics ), monthly_regret AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(spending.spent_at, '%Y-%m') AS spend_month, SUM(CASE WHEN review.review_type = 'REGRET' THEN spending.amount ELSE 0 END) AS regret_amount, COUNT(review.review_id) AS reviewed_count FROM spending LEFT JOIN spending_review review ON review.spending_id = spending.spending_id AND review.del_yn = 'N' WHERE spending.user_id = #{userId} AND spending.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(spending.spent_at, '%Y-%m') ), saving_account_progress AS ( SELECT account.account_id, account.user_id, CASE WHEN account.account_status = 'MATURED' THEN 100.0 ELSE LEAST( 100.0, ROUND( account.monthly_count * 100.0 / NULLIF( LEAST( 24, GREATEST( 1, TIMESTAMPDIFF( MONTH, DATE(COALESCE(account.open_date, account.created_date)), member.discharge_date) ) ), 0), 1) ) END AS progress FROM saving_account account JOIN `user` member ON account.user_id = member.id WHERE account.user_id = #{userId} AND account.del_yn = 'N' AND account.account_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'MATURED') AND ( account.account_status = 'MATURED' OR ( COALESCE(account.open_date, account.created_date) IS NOT NULL AND member.discharge_date IS NOT NULL ) ) ), saving_progress AS ( SELECT user_id, ROUND(AVG(progress), 1) AS progress FROM saving_account_progress GROUP BY user_id ), badge_metrics AS ( SELECT ranked.peer_position, ranked.total_count, COALESCE(progress.progress, 0.0) AS saving_progress FROM (SELECT #{userId} AS user_id) me LEFT JOIN ranked_metrics ranked ON ranked.user_id = me.user_id LEFT JOIN saving_progress progress ON progress.user_id = me.user_id ) SELECT earned_badges.badge_id FROM ( SELECT 1 AS badge_id FROM badge_metrics WHERE peer_position * 100.0 / total_count <= 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 FROM badge_metrics WHERE peer_position * 100.0 / total_count <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT 3 FROM badge_metrics WHERE peer_position * 100.0 / total_count <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 4 FROM badge_metrics WHERE peer_position * 100.0 / total_count <= 30 UNION ALL SELECT 5 FROM badge_metrics WHERE saving_progress >= 50 UNION ALL SELECT 6 FROM badge_metrics WHERE saving_progress >= 75 UNION ALL SELECT 7 FROM badge_metrics WHERE saving_progress >= 100 UNION ALL SELECT 8 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM monthly_regret last_month JOIN monthly_regret prev_month ON prev_month.spend_month = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB( STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(last_month.spend_month, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ), '%Y-%m' ) WHERE last_month.spend_month = DATE_FORMAT( DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AND last_month.reviewed_count > 0 AND prev_month.reviewed_count > 0 AND last_month.regret_amount < prev_month.regret_amount ) ) earned_badges JOIN badge ON earned_badges.badge_id = badge.badge_id AND badge.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY earned_badges.badge_id
